headlines.title: Starbucks is ready for the holidays with its new seasonal menu
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi samples the latest items from Starbucks' (SBUX) seasonal menu and shares his thoughts.

headlines.title: AMD CEO Su on earnings outlook, new Starbucks holiday menu, and Hilton CEO on hotel demand
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi tackles the biggest news of the market day, including AMD's (AMD) earnings outlook topping estimates as chip demand soars, what the blue wave in Congress means for a market rally, and how Starbucks (SBUX) plans its business around the holiday season with new products. Sozzi also goes 1-on-1 with Hilton (HLT) CEO Chris Nassetta to discuss AI's impact on the hospitality industry.

headlines.title: Starbucks Served Up a 54% Earnings Jump. The SBUX Comeback Story Is Brewing.
headlines.summary: Starbucks still has challenges, but its latest earnings report suggests the worst of its sales slowdown could be behind it.

headlines.title: McDonald’s Rises 5% as Earnings Beat Outweighs U.S. Sales Dip; Chipotle Climbs 4%, Starbucks Gains 3%
headlines.summary: McDonald's posted its first U.S. same-store sales decline in over a year, yet the stock is surging and dragging the entire restaurant sector along with it. The reason investors are cheering a miss tells you something important about where the fast food industry stands right now.

headlines.title: Is China Licensing Shift Altering The Investment Case For Starbucks (SBUX)?
headlines.summary: Starbucks reported past quarterly revenue of US$9,141.2 million, lower than a year earlier, while net income and diluted EPS were higher for both the quarter and full year. Management guided to about a 1% consolidated net revenue decline for fiscal 2027, tied largely to the China licensing transition and the 53rd week effect.

description: Starbucks Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a roaster, marketer, and retailer of coffee internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Channel Development. Its stores offer coffee, tea, and other beverages, roasted whole beans and ground coffees, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve products, and ready-to-drink beverages; and various food products, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items. The company also licenses its trademarks through licensed stores, and grocery and foodservice accounts. The company offers its products under the Starbucks Coffee, Teavana, Seattle's Best Coffee, Ethos, and Starbucks Reserve brands. Starbucks Corporation was founded in 1971 and is based in Seattle, Washington.
